subject: Music Production
title: Mashups and the Grey Album
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Mashups and the Grey Album.

hook.text: In 2004, DJ Danger Mouse mixed Jay-Z's 'The Black Album' vocals over The Beatles' 'White Album' instrumentals.

buildup.text: The result, called 'The Grey Album,' spread virally online and was praised by music critics everywhere.

discovery.text: EMI, The Beatles' label, issued cease-and-desist letters, trying to prevent distribution.

twist.text: Activists organized 'Grey Tuesday,' where hundreds of websites hosted the album in protest.

climax.text: The Grey Album became a cultural flashpoint in the debate over sampling, remix, and copyright.

punchline.text: An illegal mashup became a landmark for remix culture.

quiz.question: What was 'Grey Tuesday'?
options: A protest where websites hosted the banned Grey Album
